result: I fixed the audit warning. `PostController.store` no longer uses `forceCreate` with request data. It now calls `Post.create({ title, excerpt, body, publishedAt }, { set: { authorId } })`, so the author still comes from the session and never from the request. `guren audit --no-deps` now reports no findings, and `bun run typecheck` passes. I did not re-run the full gate or any tests.
